name: 358-chase-rabbits
notes: #358 B2.c chase the rabbits: three kids and the real herd (Sim.Eco.RabbitHerd.Scare against every doll, as RabbitView runs it). View/Beats/KidPlay.cs RabbitChaseGame: the kids walk round to the herd's side, one points, all creep up crouched from different sides (50 degrees apart), then charge arms up; the first one inside the rabbits' alert radius (0.55 u) is the Contact, the rabbits sit up and bolt; the kids run on, slow, hands on knees, then laugh one after the other (the end beat) and sit. hitReach 0.6: the contact is the scare at the alert radius, not a touch.
